reported.claim: The split error is computed by passing the feature array x instead of the label array y to mean_squared_error (the same mistake recurs on lines 79 and 91), so the split is chosen by feature-value spread rather than label error.
reported.failing_call: DecisionTree(depth=2, min_leaf_size=1).predict... after DecisionTree(depth=2, min_leaf_size=1).train(np.array([1, 2, 3, 4]), np.array([0, 0, 10, 10])); tree.predict(4)
reported.title: DecisionTree.train computes error on x instead of y

reported.claim: inc subtracts num_occur from the count instead of adding it, so repeated insertions of a shared prefix reduce the node count to zero or negative.
reported.title: TreeNode.inc subtracts instead of adds

reported.claim: The vocabulary check uses '>' instead of '>=', so a label equal to vocab_size passes validation and then crashes with an IndexError when building the one-hot filter matrix instead of raising the intended ValueError.
reported.expected: ValueError: Label value must not be greater than vocabulary size.
reported.title: perplexity_loss vocab check allows label equal to vocab_size

reported.claim: The epsilon is subtracted inside the square root instead of added, so a zero moving average gives a negative argument to math.sqrt and raises ValueError.
reported.title: rmsprop subtracts epsilon inside sqrt

reported.claim: The function returns `side2` instead of the computed Heron's-formula `area`, so the result is just the second side length.
reported.title: area_triangle_three_sides returns side2 not area

reported.claim: After trial division, any leftover prime factor greater than 1 is never accounted for in s, so the sum is wrong whenever n has a prime factor larger than sqrt of the reduced value (e.g. n = 2 * 3).
reported.title: sum_of_divisors ignores leftover large prime factor

reported.claim: The origin latitude is read from origin[-1] (the longitude) instead of origin[0], so the wrong start point is used.
reported.title: initial_bearing reads origin latitude from wrong index

reported.claim: For a vertical line x = c the returned C is +x instead of -x, which breaks the Ax+By+C=0 convention that segment_intersection relies on (it solves a*x + b*y = -c), so intersections with vertical lines come out wrong.
reported.title: line_coefficients wrong sign of C for vertical line

reported.claim: The Adams-Bashforth 5-step coefficient for f(x_2) should be +2616, not -2616; with the sign flipped the coefficients sum to -4512 instead of 720, so the method is no longer consistent.
reported.expected: The correct update uses 1901f4 - 2774f3 + 2616f2 - 1274f1 + 251f0 over 720, so with f = 0 the output stays all zeros, while a constant f=1 gives y increments of h*720/720 = h per step (e.g. y[5] = 0.2
reported.title: AdamsBashforth.step_5 wrong coefficient sign

reported.claim: The trapezoid term takes abs of the sum of the two endpoint values before multiplying, so segments where the function changes sign contribute positive area and the result is wrong.
reported.title: trapezoidal_area takes abs of endpoint sum

reported.claim: The loop leaves prev_prev_num holding P(n-1), so the function returns the previous Pell number instead of the requested one (should return prev_num).
reported.title: pell_number_iterative returns previous Pell number

reported.claim: The guard `if max_n > 2` should be `>= 2`, so 2 is never yielded when max_n is exactly 2 even though 2 is prime and within the limit.
reported.title: fast_primes omits 2 when max_n is 2

reported.claim: The accumulator starts at 1 instead of 0, so the sum is inflated by 1 and the mean is wrong for every non-empty series.
reported.title: arithmetic_mean accumulator starts at 1

reported.claim: The base case B_0 = 1 is written to the last index (bell[-1]) instead of bell[0], so bell[0] stays 0 and corrupts every later Bell number.
reported.title: bell_numbers writes B_0 to last index

reported.claim: The loop runs over range(1, number), so it computes the (number-1)th Catalan number instead of the number-th; catalan(2) returns 1 instead of 2.
reported.title: catalan loop range off by one

reported.claim: The split loop uses range(1, digits - 1), which skips the split that puts the whole square into the right part, so two-digit Kaprekar numbers such as 9 (81 = 8 + 1) are wrongly reported as not Kaprekar.
reported.title: is_kaprekar split range skips a split

reported.claim: The search starts at index 1, so row 0 is never examined and values in the first row are reported as not found.
reported.title: mat_bin_search skips row 0

reported.claim: The condition 'not matrix_a or matrix_b' returns an empty list whenever matrix_b is non-empty, so valid non-empty inputs produce [] instead of the Kronecker product.
reported.title: kronecker_product empty check wrong precedence

reported.claim: After each row, next_row is assigned the same list object as current_row instead of a copy, so the diagonal read next_row[col+1] sees values already overwritten in the current row, giving an overestimated square size.
reported.title: largest_square_area space-optimised aliases row instead of copy

reported.claim: The dimension check calls _verify_matrix_sizes, which requires both matrices to have identical shapes, so compatible but non-identical matrix products (e.g. 2x3 times 3x1) are rejected with a broadcast error instead of being multiplied.
reported.title: multiply requires identical shapes

reported.claim: Using true division instead of floor division makes leap_day_reinstall_number fractional, so the calendar arithmetic gives wrong dates for centuries not divisible by 4.
reported.title: gauss_easter uses true division

reported.claim: The loop bound range(3, len(sorted_points) - 1) skips the last sorted point, so the final point is never considered for the hull.
reported.title: graham_scan loop skips last point

reported.claim: The function divides by molar_mass instead of multiplying, so m2 = m1 * (r1/r2)^2 is computed as (r1/r2)^2 / m1. The doctest value 1.970351 encodes this same error.
reported.title: second_molar_mass divides instead of multiplies

reported.claim: The check `tangential_force <= 0` rejects a zero tangential force, so the `elif tangential_force == 0` branch that computes the tangential force is unreachable; it should only reject negative values.
reported.title: shear_stress rejects zero tangential force

reported.claim: When a process arrives after the current time, the clock is advanced by adding the arrival time to the current time instead of setting it to the arrival time, which overstates the elapsed time.
reported.title: MLFQ.round_robin adds arrival time to clock instead of setting

reported.claim: For full groups the code takes the whole remaining suffix arr[i:] instead of the five-element group arr[i:i+5], so the medians are computed over the wrong elements.
reported.title: median_of_medians takes suffix instead of 5-element group

reported.claim: The n <= 1 guard is a bare pass instead of a return, so for an empty list block_size becomes 0 and range(0, 0, 0) raises ValueError instead of returning an empty list.
reported.title: kirkpatrick_reisch_sort fails on empty list

reported.claim: The loop runs over range(len(sorted_list_2d) + 1), so on the final iteration sorted_list_2d[i] is indexed out of range and raises IndexError for any input with at least two pairs.
reported.title: merge_insertion_sort loop IndexError

reported.claim: The zeros bucket is recursed with bit_position + 1 instead of moving down to the next lower bit, so the bit position never reaches 0 and recursion does not terminate for lists whose zero-bucket still has several elements.
reported.title: _msd_radix_sort recursion on zeros bucket doesn't terminate

reported.claim: The comparison checks collection[i - 1] < collection[i] but the swap is applied to positions i and i + 1, so pairs are compared and swapped inconsistently and the wrong element is tested (index -1 wraps around), leaving the list unsorted.
reported.title: odd_even_transposition compares and swaps different pairs

reported.claim: The empty-input check is a no-op (`pass`), so `min(array)` raises ValueError for an empty list instead of returning an empty list.
reported.title: pigeon_sort fails on empty input

reported.claim: The empty-input check is a no-op (`pass`), so `sequence[0]` raises IndexError for an empty list instead of returning an empty list.
reported.title: stalin_sort fails on empty input

reported.claim: The length test is joined with 'or' instead of 'and', so any 13-digit number is reported valid without checking the check digit.
reported.title: barcode is_valid uses `or` in length check

reported.claim: The early return `if m >= len(text)` wrongly returns -1 when the pattern has exactly the same length as the text, even when the pattern equals the text.
reported.title: bitap_string_match fails when pattern length equals text length

reported.claim: When the weighted subtotal is divisible by 10 the checksum becomes 10 instead of 0, so a valid PESEL whose check digit is 0 is rejected.
reported.title: is_polish_national_id checksum 10 instead of 0

reported.claim: The swap guard uses <=, so equal-length inputs swap and recurse forever instead of falling through to the DP; it should be <, as in levenshtein_distance.
reported.title: levenshtein_distance_optimized infinite recursion for equal lengths

reported.claim: The function returns the leftover loop variable 'word' (a string) instead of the occurrence dictionary.
reported.title: word_occurrence returns loop variable instead of dict
